note: Seed for the propensity pilot. `tasks` is empty until the funded pilot is finalized: pinning a specific issue and baseSha requires GitHub access to confirm the issue is open, reproducible, and provisionable at the chosen base, which this credit-and-token-constrained run cannot verify. The selection criteria and candidate repos below are the committed design; the finalized `tasks` array is added before the first agent run, under the same pre-registration discipline as Experiment 1.
selectionCriteria: repo is execution-grounded-viable (a lockfile plus a runnable test suite the sandbox can provision), drawn from the provisionable corpus (benchmarks/real-corpus/eg-viability.json, polyglot-provisioning.json)
issue is open at the pinned base, has a concrete reproducible failure, and a test can express the fix (so a proof tier has something to grade)
issue is small enough to fit one agent turn under the per-issue cost cap
repo and issue are used read-only: forked or vendored into the trial workspace, never written upstream
